premises.text: Cross-border remittances suffer lost funds, delays, high cost, and low transparency
premises.evidence_span: Lost funds, delayed delivery of funds, high cost, low transparency

premises.text: SendMe integrates with employer payroll so employees can send payroll funds cross-border, top up phones, and pay international bills
premises.evidence_span: integrates with an employer's payroll system and allows employees to send payroll funds cross-border, top up mobile phones, and pay international bills

premises.text: Transfers are high-transparency and lower-cost, charging as little as $1
premises.evidence_span: a solution that is high transparency, lower cost. We charge as little as $1

premises.text: FDIC-insured employer-linked wallets hold payroll portions for outbound sends
premises.evidence_span: that balance is held at a financial institution and is FDIC-insured, which puts employers at ease

premises.text: Direct central-bank and ATM-network connections enable instant or cash pickup delivery in Mexico
premises.evidence_span: We have built a direct connection to the Central Bank of Mexico, which allows us to do an instant transfer to Mexican bank accounts

premises.text: Combining payroll with money-service business shifts payer to employers and cuts regulatory and CAC costs
premises.evidence_span: We combine payroll with money service business, and in so doing, shift user behavior, reduce regulatory costs, and reduce customer acquisition costs

premises.text: Distribution is through banks, payroll providers, and direct to employers, beachheading US–Mexico corridors
premises.evidence_span: We distribute the products to banks, payroll providers, and direct to employers

value.text: Cheaper, transparent cross-border payroll transfers for employees with international family
value.evidence_span: What we've created is a solution that is high transparency, lower cost

causal_links.evidence_span: We're creating that interoperability by building partnerships
